headline: Oil Tanker Crippled by Mystery Projectile off Oman in Strait of Hormuz Amid Iran Sanctions War
summary: An oil tanker was disabled in the Strait of Hormuz off Oman after being hit by an unknown projectile. The incident is raising concerns over global energy supply routes amid US-Iran tensions.
why: The Strait of Hormuz carries a large share of the world's seaborne oil, so any disruption there quickly affects crude prices and shipping insurance.
why_moved: A tanker was disabled in a key oil transit corridor amid US-Iran tensions, raising fears of supply disruption.
